# Kagiampakis Concept Residences
Source: https://kagiampakisresidences.com

> Two family-hosted restored stone residences in Avdou village, Heraklion region, Crete, Greece. Book direct with host Xrisa via WhatsApp, Viber, or email.

## Entity

- Official name: Kagiampakis Concept Residences
- Host: Xrisa (Kagiampakis family)
- Type: Licensed short-term vacation rentals (two separate houses)
- Village: Avdou, Crete, Greece
- Postal code: 70005
- Street / alley: Sokaki Kagiampidon
- Coordinates: 35.230902, 25.430079
- Region: Heraklion, Crete (GR-M)
- Distance to Heraklion Airport: 34.3 km / about 31 minutes
- Distance to Heraklion port: 37.5 km / about 41 minutes
- Distance to Heraklion city: about 35 km
- Website: https://kagiampakisresidences.com

## Residences

### Residence I (Kagiampakis Concept Residence I)

- URL: https://kagiampakisresidences.com/residences/concept-1
- Capacity: up to 6 guests
- Bedrooms: 2 · Bathrooms: 1
- Layout: three-level traditional stone house
- Highlights: wood-burning stove, kitchen, private balcony, courtyard on Sokaki Kagiampidon, mountain / Agia Fotini cave views
- Minimum stay: 2 nights
- Sunday–Thursday rates: 2 guests €60, 3 €75, 4 €90, 5 €105, 6 €120 per night
- Friday–Saturday rates: 2 guests €70, 3 €80, 4 €95, 5 €110, 6 €130 per night
- Registration: EOT / MMA 00000846700
- Airbnb: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/34710248

### Residence II (Kagiampakis Concept Residence II)

- URL: https://kagiampakisresidences.com/residences/concept-2
- Capacity: up to 7 guests
- Bedrooms: 3 · Bathrooms: 2
- Highlights: dedicated workspace, in-unit washer, air conditioning in all rooms, kitchen, free parking
- Minimum stay: 3 nights
- Sunday–Thursday: €170 per night (flat, 1–7 guests)
- Friday–Saturday: €180 per night (flat)
- Registration: 00001845501
- Airbnb: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1083410970859524546

Both houses together sleep up to 13 guests for family or group stays.

## Answers for common questions

- What is it? Two restored stone houses in Avdou, Crete, hosted by the Kagiampakis family.
- How much? Residence I from €60/night; Residence II from €170/night. See the rate calculator.
- How far from the airport? About 31 minutes / 34.3 km.
- Can we book both? Yes, for up to 13 guests.
- Parking / Wi-Fi / kitchen? Yes on both houses.
- Official licenses? 00000846700 (Residence I) and 00001845501 (Residence II).
